help.SumOffice:
**Open and edit Word, Excel and PowerPoint files of Documents in SumOffice.**

**Discovery URL** — the WOPI discovery address of the SumOffice editors as the EspoCRM server reaches it, e.g. `https://office.example.com/hosting/discovery`. Save, then press **Check connection**.

**Verify WOPI proof** — every call from the editors is checked against the proof key published in discovery. Keep it on.

**CA bundle** — a path on the EspoCRM server, only when the editors use a certificate from a private CA.

**Open the editor** — *Automatically* opens it inside EspoCRM when the editors are on the same site as EspoCRM (`office.example.com` next to `crm.example.com`) and as a whole browser tab otherwise, because a browser refuses the editor's cookie in a frame from another site.

The editors must allow this EspoCRM: its `siteUrl` is the address they call back. Guide: [sumoffice.com/espocrm.html](https://sumoffice.com/espocrm.html).
